def design(feats):
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y0 = np.asarray(feats.y, float); n, p = X.shape
    ids = list(feats.ids); st = np.array([str(s) for s in feats.stratum])
    labs = sorted(set(st))
    S = np.column_stack([np.ones(n)] + [(st == l).astype(float) for l in labs[1:]])
    R = np.corrcoef(X, rowvar=False)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)

    def ll(M, y):
        b = np.zeros(M.shape[1])
        for _ in range(25):
            pr = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(M @ b, -30, 30)))
            H = M.T @ (M * (pr * (1 - pr))[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(M.shape[1])
            d = np.linalg.solve(H, M.T @ (y - pr)); b += d
            if np.abs(d).max() < 1e-7: break
        pr = np.clip(1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(M @ b, -30, 30))), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
        return float(np.sum(y * np.log(pr) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - pr)))

    def fit(cols, y, extra=()):
        return ll(np.column_stack([S] + [X[:, j] for j in cols] + list(extra)), y)

    def scores(sel, y, base, C=None):
        C = X if C is None else C
        # fast score test for adding each candidate given current model
        M = np.column_stack([S] + [X[:, j] for j in sel])
        b = np.linalg.lstsq(M, np.zeros(n), rcond=None)[0] * 0
        for _ in range(25):
            pr = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(M @ b, -30, 30)))
            W = pr * (1 - pr)
            d = np.linalg.solve(M.T @ (M * W[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(M.shape[1]), M.T @ (y - pr)); b += d
            if np.abs(d).max() < 1e-7: break
        pr = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(M @ b, -30, 30))); W = pr * (1 - pr); r = y - pr
        Q = M * np.sqrt(W)[:, None]
        Xw = C * np.sqrt(W)[:, None]
        Xres = Xw - Q @ np.linalg.lstsq(Q, Xw, rcond=None)[0]
        return (C.T @ r) ** 2 / np.maximum((Xres ** 2).sum(0), 1e-12)

    def greedy(y, crit):
        sel = []; base = fit(sel, y); null = base; T = np.zeros(MAX_DRIVERS)
        while len(sel) < MAX_DRIVERS:
            sc = scores(sel, y, base)
            for k in sel: sc[np.abs(R[:, k]) >= 0.6] = -1
            j = int(np.argmax(sc))
            if sc[j] < crit: break
            new = fit(sel + [j], y)
            if 2 * (new - base) < crit: break
            sel.append(j); base = new; T[len(sel) - 1:] = 2 * (base - null)
        return sel, T

    crit = stats.chi2.isf(0.01, 1)
    sel, T = greedy(y0, crit)
    if sel:
        perm = []
        for _ in range(300):
            yp = y0.copy()
            for l in labs:
                m = np.where(st == l)[0]; yp[m] = y0[rng.permutation(m)]
            perm.append(greedy(yp, crit)[1])
        q = np.quantile(np.array(perm), 0.995, axis=0)
        ok = [k for k in range(len(sel)) if T[k] > q[k]]
        sel = sel[:max(ok) + 1] if ok else []
        while len(sel) > 1:
            full = fit(sel, y0)
            d = [2 * (full - fit([k for k in sel if k != j], y0)) for j in sel]
            if min(d) >= crit: break
            sel.pop(int(np.argmin(d)))
    prods = []
    pairs = [(i, j) for i in range(p) for j in range(i, p) if abs(R[i, j]) < 0.6 or i == j]
    Z = np.column_stack([X[:, i] * X[:, j] for i, j in pairs])
    ps = scores(sel, y0, None, Z)
    cp = stats.chi2.isf(0.002 / len(pairs), 1)
    for k in np.argsort(-ps)[:8]:
        i, j = pairs[k]; mains = sel + [m for m in (i, j) if m not in sel]
        if 2 * (fit(mains, y0, [Z[:, k]]) - fit(mains, y0)) >= cp:
            prods.append((ids[i], ids[j])); sel = mains
            break
    drivers = tuple(ids[j] for j in sel)[:MAX_DRIVERS]
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=drivers, products=tuple(prods), loadings={})

        M = np.column_stack([S] + [X[:, j] for j in sel])
        b = np.linalg.lstsq(M, np.zeros(n), rcond=None)[0] * 0

            W = pr * (1 - pr)
            d = np.linalg.solve(M.T @ (M * W[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(M.shape[1]), M.T @ (y - pr)); b += d
            if np.abs(d).max() < 1e-7: break
        pr = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(M @ b, -30, 30))); W = pr * (1 - pr); r = y - pr
        Q = M * np.sqrt(W)[:, None]

    def greedy(y, crit):

    ps = scores(sel, y0, None, Z)
